corrections.text: The article states that Shacknews "reports the games are available to subscribers of any Xbox Game Pass tier, and players can also buy them individually." Shacknews's article confirms only the Game Pass tier availability; it does not mention individual purchase anywhere in its text. The individual-purchase fact is accurate but is sourced from Xbox Wire ("Each of these games is now available for purchase on PC") and TheSixthAxis ("now to purchase on PC"), not from Shacknews.
